name: Auto Swingshot
author: glawks
description: Experimental RAC1 Swingshot target detection with opt-in auto-equip.

settings.name: Swingshot activation
settings.description: Automatically equip Swingshot when Circle is pressed near a detected target. Observe mode logs candidates without switching. Restart after changing.

settings.name: Target radius
settings.description: Approximate distance in game units, not retail targeting.

settings.name: Height difference
settings.description: Maximum vertical separation in game units.
